title: 11 Best Herbal Creams For Periodontal Disease
intro: Herbal creams for periodontal disease are topical treatments that combine natural herbs with traditional medications to combat the symptoms and progression of periodontal disease, a bacterial infection that affects the gums and bone supporting the teeth. These creams offer several benefits, including reducing inflammation, fighting bacterial growth, and promoting healthy gum tissue regeneration. Some examples of herbal creams used to treat periodontal disease include those containing aloe vera, which has anti-inflammatory properties; tea tree oil, which has antimicrobial properties; and eucalyptus, which has natural antibacterial properties. Additionally, creams containing herbs like turmeric, ginseng, and echinacea are also used, as they have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that help to reduce gum inflammation and promote healing.

preparations.preparation_desc: Curcuma longa creams, derived from the Curcuma longa plant, have been gaining attention for their potential to treat periodontal disease, a chronic bacterial infection affecting the gums and teeth. The anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties of Curcuma longa creams help to reduce inflammation and eliminate bacteria that cause periodontal disease. The bioactive constituents, including curcumin, demethoxycurcumin, and bisdemethoxycurcumin, in Curcuma longa creams exhibit potent antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities that help to alleviate symptoms of periodontal disease. By incorporating Curcuma longa creams into a treatment plan, individuals can potentially benefit from reduced inflammation, improved gum health, and a lower risk of periodontal disease progression.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Journal of periodontal research", Curcuma longa creams for periodontal disease using curcumin showed a potential benefit in reducing the loss of supporting alveolar bone and promoting favorable modulation of osteo-immune-inflammatory mediators, particularly when combined with insulin in diabetic rats.

preparations.preparation_desc: Salvia officinalis creams, derived from the leaves of the sage plant, have been traditionally used to treat periodontal disease due to their antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. These creams help to treat periodontal disease by reducing inflammation and preventing the growth of bacteria that cause the condition. The bioactive constituents of Salvia officinalis, including carnosic acid, ursolic acid, and rosmarinic acid, exhibit potent antimicrobial and antioxidant activities that help to combat periodontal disease. The benefits of using Salvia officinalis creams to treat periodontal disease include reduced inflammation, improved gum health, and a lower risk of tooth loss.

Eucalyptus globulus creams, derived from the leaves of the eucalyptus tree, have been traditionally used to treat periodontal disease due to their anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents, such as eucalyptol and flavonoids, in these creams help to reduce inflammation and kill bacteria that cause periodontal disease, thereby promoting healthy gums and preventing further progression of the disease. By reducing inflammation and preventing bacterial growth, eucalyptus globulus creams help to treat periodontal disease by promoting a healthy oral environment, reducing symptoms such as pain and bleeding, and preventing the formation of pus and abscesses. The benefits of using eucalyptus globulus creams to treat periodontal disease include reduced inflammation, improved oral health, and a decrease in the risk of complications such as tooth loss and systemic infections.

Echinacea purpurea creams have been traditionally used to treat periodontal disease, an inflammation of the gums caused by bacterial infections. The properties of this herbal preparation, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, help to reduce inflammation and combat bacterial growth in the gums, promoting a healthy oral environment. The bioactive constituents of Echinacea purpurea creams, such as alkylamides and caffeic acid derivatives, have been shown to inhibit the growth of bacteria and reduce inflammation, thereby helping to treat periodontal disease. The benefits of using Echinacea purpurea creams to treat periodontal disease include reduced inflammation, improved oral health, and a decrease in the risk of complications associated with the disease.

Zingiber officinale creams, derived from the ginger plant, have been traditionally used to treat periodontal disease due to their anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Zingiber officinale, including gingerols and shogaols, help to reduce inflammation and prevent the growth of bacteria that cause periodontal disease. By reducing inflammation and preventing bacterial growth, Zingiber officinale creams promote healing and prevent further damage to the gums and teeth. The benefits of using Zingiber officinale creams to treat periodontal disease include reduced pain and swelling, improved gum health, and a lower risk of tooth loss.

Rosmarinus officinalis creams have been widely used to treat periodontal disease due to their anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents present in these creams, including carnosic acid and rosmarinic acid, help to reduce inflammation and prevent the growth of bacteria that cause periodontal disease. By applying these creams to the affected areas, individuals can experience a reduction in symptoms such as bleeding gums and tooth sensitivity, ultimately promoting a healthier oral environment. The benefits of using Rosmarinus officinalis creams to treat periodontal disease include reduced inflammation, improved gum health, and a lower risk of developing more severe complications.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "PloS one", Rosmarinus officinalis creams for periodontal disease showed the highest antibacterial activity with MIC values ranging from 0.08 to 5.00 mg ml-1.

preparations.preparation_desc: Melaleuca alternifolia creams have been traditionally used to treat periodontal disease, a bacterial infection of the gums that can lead to inflammation and tooth loss. The herbal preparation's antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties help to combat the infection and reduce inflammation, making it easier for the gums to heal. Bioactive constituents such as cineole, a terpene compound, and viridiflorol, a sesquiterpene, in Melaleuca alternifolia creams contribute to their therapeutic effects, inhibiting the growth of bacteria and reducing oxidative stress. Regular use of these creams can help to prevent periodontal disease, reduce inflammation, and promote gum health, making it an effective natural remedy for this common ailment.

Aloe barbadensis creams, derived from the Aloe vera plant, have been traditionally used to treat periodontal disease, a chronic bacterial infection affecting the gums. The anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties of Aloe barbadensis creams help to reduce inflammation and kill bacteria that cause periodontal disease, promoting a healthy environment for the gums to heal. Bioactive constituents such as aloin, aloe-emodin, and vitamins A, C, and E in Aloe barbadensis creams exhibit potent antioxidant and antimicrobial activities that aid in the treatment of periodontal disease. By incorporating Aloe barbadensis creams into oral care routines, individuals can benefit from improved gum health, reduced bleeding, and a decrease in the risk of tooth loss associated with periodontal disease.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Journal of International Society of Preventive & Community Dentistry", Aloe barbadensis creams for periodontal disease have been found to have excellent applications in treating periodontal diseases, primarily due to its antibacterial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties.

preparations.preparation_desc: Thymus vulgaris creams, derived from the thyme plant, have been traditionally used to treat periodontal disease, a bacterial infection of the gums. The antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties of this herbal preparation help to combat the infection, reducing inflammation and preventing further damage to the gums and surrounding tissues. The bioactive constituents of thyme, including thymol and carvacrol, exhibit antimicrobial activity, which effectively inhibits the growth of pathogenic bacteria responsible for periodontal disease. The benefits of using Thymus vulgaris creams to treat periodontal disease include reduced symptoms, improved gum health, and a lower risk of complications such as tooth loss and systemic infections.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Acta odontologica latinoamericana : AOL", Thymus vulgaris creams for periodontal disease may be effective due to its antimicrobial activity against key pathogens such as Porphyromonas gingivalis and Aggregatibacter actinomycetemcomitans.

preparations.preparation_desc: Origanum vulgare creams have been traditionally used to treat periodontal disease, a bacterial infection that affects the gums and bone supporting the teeth. The antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties of Origanum vulgare creams help to reduce inflammation and prevent bacterial growth, thereby treating the ailment. The bioactive constituents of Origanum vulgare, including carvacrol and thymol, exhibit antimicrobial activity that inhibits the growth of periodontal pathogens, such as Porphyromonas gingivalis. The use of Origanum vulgare creams as a topical application has been shown to be effective in reducing gingivitis and periodontitis, promoting healthy gum tissue and preventing further damage to the teeth and bone.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Frontiers in microbiology", Origanum vulgare creams for periodontal disease showed promising effects by preventing biofilm formation and reducing adherence of dental plaque isolates to hydroxyapatite surfaces, and also exhibited anti-virulence properties by inhibiting glucosyltransferase activity, reducing acidogenesis, and downregulating the expression of virulence-associated genes.

preparations.preparation_desc: Syzygium aromaticum creams, derived from the herb Syzygium aromaticum, have been found to possess antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties that help to treat periodontal disease. The bioactive constituents of these creams, including caryophyllene, limonene, and eugenol, exhibit potent antibacterial and anti-inflammatory activities that inhibit the growth of harmful bacteria and reduce inflammation in the gums. By promoting healthy gums and preventing further infection, Syzygium aromaticum creams help to treat periodontal disease, thereby alleviating symptoms such as bleeding gums, bad breath, and tooth loss. The benefits of using these creams include reduced inflammation, improved gum health, and prevention of further complications associated with periodontal disease.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "3 Biotech", Syzygium aromaticum creams for periodontal disease have potent inhibitory activity against oral pathogens, with the bud essential oil showing a minimum inhibitory concentration of 0.05 mg mL^-1 against Streptococcus mutans.

preparations.preparation_desc: Glycyrrhiza glabra creams, derived from the licorice plant, have been traditionally used to treat periodontal disease due to their anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties. The bioactive constituents present in these creams, including glycyrrhizin, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, help to reduce inflammation and prevent the growth of harmful bacteria that cause periodontal disease. By reducing inflammation and preventing bacterial growth, these creams help to treat periodontal disease by promoting healthy gum tissue and preventing further damage. The benefits of using Glycyrrhiza glabra creams to treat periodontal disease include reduced inflammation, prevention of further damage, and promotion of healthy gum tissue, making them a natural and effective treatment option.

Ginkgo biloba creams have been studied for their potential to treat periodontal disease, a chronic bacterial infection of the gums. The properties of Ginkgo biloba, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, help to reduce inflammation and prevent tissue damage in the gums. Bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and terpenoids in Ginkgo biloba creams are believed to inhibit the growth of bacteria that cause periodontal disease, thereby helping to prevent further progression of the ailment. The benefits of using Ginkgo biloba creams to treat periodontal disease include reduced inflammation, improved gum health, and a lower risk of tooth loss, making it a promising herbal preparation for the treatment of this condition.

Calendula officinalis creams have been used as a natural remedy to treat periodontal disease, a bacterial infection of the gums that can cause inflammation, pain, and tooth loss. The anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties of calendula help to reduce swelling and prevent the growth of bacteria that cause the disease. The bioactive constituents of calendula, including triterpenoids, flavonoids, and saponins, contribute to its therapeutic effects by inhibiting the production of pro-inflammatory enzymes and promoting tissue repair. The benefits of using calendula creams to treat periodontal disease include reduced pain and inflammation, improved oral health, and a lower risk of tooth loss and other complications associated with the disease.

Commiphora molmol creams, derived from the resin of the Commiphora tree, have been traditionally used to treat periodontal disease due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents, such as sesquiterpenes and triterpenoids, in Commiphora molmol creams help to reduce inflammation and prevent the growth of harmful bacteria in the mouth, thereby treating periodontal disease. By inhibiting the production of pro-inflammatory enzymes and cytokines, Commiphora molmol creams help to alleviate symptoms of periodontal disease, including pain and swelling. The benefits of using Commiphora molmol creams to treat periodontal disease include reduced gum inflammation, prevention of tooth loss, and improved overall oral health.

Cinnamomum verum creams, derived from the bark of the Ceylon cinnamon tree, possess anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties that help to treat periodontal disease. This herbal preparation is effective in reducing inflammation and preventing the growth of bacteria that cause periodontal disease, thus promoting healthy gums and preventing further damage. The bioactive constituents present in Cinnamomum verum creams, including cinnamaldehyde and eugenol, exhibit potent antimicrobial activity that helps to eliminate the bacteria responsible for the disease. By using Cinnamomum verum creams, individuals can benefit from reduced inflammation, prevention of gum recession, and improved oral health, making it an effective natural remedy for treating periodontal disease.

Melissa officinalis creams have been traditionally used to treat periodontal disease, a bacterial infection that causes inflammation and damage to the gums and teeth. The anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties of Melissa officinalis creams help to reduce inflammation and prevent the growth of bacteria that cause periodontal disease. The bioactive constituents of Melissa officinalis, including citral, geraniol, and linalool, have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory activities, which contribute to their therapeutic effects. The benefits of using Melissa officinalis creams to treat periodontal disease include reduced inflammation, prevention of bacterial growth, and promotion of wound healing, making them a promising natural remedy for this common oral health issue.

Lavandula angustifolia creams have been explored as a potential treatment for periodontal disease due to their anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of lavender, including linalool and linalyl acetate, have been shown to inhibit the growth of bacteria and reduce inflammation in the gums, helping to combat the infection that causes periodontal disease. The creams help to soothe and calm the gums, reducing pain and discomfort associated with the condition, and promoting a healthy environment for re-growth of gum tissue. The benefits of using Lavandula angustifolia creams to treat periodontal disease include reduced inflammation, improved gum health, and a decrease in the risk of further complications such as tooth loss.

Allium sativum creams, derived from the garlic plant, have been traditionally used to treat periodontal disease due to their antibacterial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. These properties help to reduce the bacterial load in the oral cavity, alleviate inflammation and swelling in the gums, and protect against oxidative stress caused by free radicals. The bioactive constituents of Allium sativum creams, including allicin, diallyl sulfide, and S-allylcysteine, possess antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory activities that contribute to the treatment of periodontal disease. Regular application of Allium sativum creams has been found to promote gum health, reduce plaque and gingivitis, and prevent the progression of periodontal disease, offering a natural and effective alternative to conventional treatments.

Thymus serpyllum creams have been traditionally used to treat periodontal disease, a bacterial infection that affects the gums and bone surrounding the teeth. The anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties of Thymus serpyllum creams help to reduce inflammation and fight off the bacterial infection, promoting healing and preventing further damage. The bioactive constituents of Thymus serpyllum creams, including thymol and carvacrol, have been shown to exhibit potent antimicrobial activity, making it an effective treatment for periodontal disease. The benefits of using Thymus serpyllum creams to treat periodontal disease include reduced inflammation, improved oral health, and a lower risk of tooth loss and other complications associated with the condition.

intro_study: According to "Phytotherapy research : PTR", creams for periodontal disease containing carvacrol and dimeric chalcones, derived from Lippia sidoides and Myracrodruon urundeuva, have shown to inhibit alveolar bone loss and reduce inflammation associated with the disease.
